边走边想的王野时而眉头紧锁，时而欣慰的一笑。全然不知走到了哪里，猛然间王野站在了一座门脸前，抬头一看“种子站”。

虽说王野没有这儿的证明，但是他也不买粮食种子呀，碰碰运气吧。推门进入，这个种子站商品也是琳琅满目，各种各样的种子，农具应有尽有。

王野走向一个年龄稍微大点儿的售货员大爷面前问道：“大爷，你们这里有药材种子吗？”

大爷一看是一个小伙子，主要的是还操着一口外地口音：“小伙子，你买什么呀？”

王野：“大爷，有人参种子吗？”

售货员大爷：“你买这东西干嘛，种出来的药效也不怎么样，也不能当饭吃。买这个干什么呀？”

王野的瞎话那是张嘴就来：“大爷，我是四九城来的，家有长辈在农科院工作，就是专门研究农作物的，研究让庄稼高产，让药材药效更好，大概就是这个吧，我也不是很清楚。”

售货员大爷：“还有研究这个的呀？”

王野：“这肯定的呀，要不然咱老百姓种什么呀，要不说新龙国，新气象呢。”

这话大爷爱听：“小伙子，你这话说的提劲儿，我们这儿确实有人参种子，可是这东西好几年了，从来没人买过，我也不知道坏了没有。”

王野：“大爷，先说好我可没有介绍信，我就是出差，家里长辈提了一嘴，你要是能卖，您就去拿，要是不能卖，咱也不强求。我回去告诉他们一声，他们要是愿意跑一趟，就让他们带着介绍信来一趟，要是嫌远，就算了。”

大爷：“这玩意儿，在我们这儿啥用没有，这又不是粮食，有没有介绍信也就那么回事儿，这东西要是到了年底还没人要，说不定就烧火用了。”

说完大爷去了后面的货架，在一堆杂物中抻出一个袋子。在秤上称了一下：“小伙子，这一共50斤，有一部分看着就不能要了，我给你算30斤，你看行不？”

王野：“大爷，您就说多少钱吧？这东西我也不懂，再说了只要不离谱，也就是那么回事儿？”

按一个后世人的思维，王野这话就是让人宰的节奏，可是这个时代这种事儿不存在的，他们可以态度不好，但是绝不丧良心。

售货员大爷：“刚才我看了一下，这人参种子售价5元一斤，这是上面定的价格，你懂的。”

王野才不会在乎这点钱呢，等个十几，二十年后，王野岂止万倍的赚回来，十万，百万都是他随意开价。从包里取出十五张大黑十递给大爷，背起袋子就离开了种子站。

背着袋子王野七拐八拐到了个没人的角落把种子收进空间，王野回到大路上，到处寻找着本地的国营饭店。他想看看能不能碰到一个厉害的大师傅，偷学点儿也不亏呀。

没走多久就看见了国营饭店，当王野点菜时就失望透了，全是素菜不说，野菜窝头都上菜单了。王野的精神力清楚的探查到，后厨是有肉的，虽说不多，但是做几个肉菜还是没问题的。

王野知道这是给熟人留的，他有自知之明，这东西现在都是大人情。可不是他三言两语都可以忽悠来的，出高价更不可能了。没人会相信一个十六岁的孩子，而且这个孩子还操着一口外地口音。

Wang Ye, who was thinking as he walked, sometimes frowned and sometimes smiled with relief.Not knowing where he was going, Wang Ye suddenly stood in front of a door and looked up at the "Seed Station".

Although Wang Ye doesn't have the proof here, he doesn't buy grain seeds either. Let's try his luck.Push the door and enter, this seed station is also full of products, including all kinds of seeds and agricultural tools.

Wang Ye walked up to an older salesman and asked, "Sir, do you have any medicinal seeds here?"

The uncle saw that he was a young man, and the most important thing was that he spoke with a foreign accent: "Young man, what are you buying?"

Wang Ye: "Uncle, are there any ginseng seeds?"

Saleslady: "Why did you buy this? The medicine you grow is not very effective, and it can't be eaten as food. What are you buying this for?"

Wang Ye's lies came out of his mouth: "Uncle, I'm from Sijiu City. My family has elders who work at the Academy of Agricultural Sciences. They specialize in studying crops. They study how to make crops more productive and medicinal materials more effective. This is probably it. I don't know very well."

Salesperson: "Is there anyone else studying this?"

Wang Ye: "That's for sure. Otherwise, what else would we people do? How about a new Dragon Kingdom and a new atmosphere?"

The old man likes to hear this: "Young man, what you said is very encouraging. We do have ginseng seeds here, but this thing has been around for several years and no one has ever bought it. I don't know if it's broken or not."

Wang Ye: "Uncle, let me tell you first that I don't have a letter of introduction. I am just on a business trip. The elders in the family have mentioned that if you can sell it, you can go and get it. If you can't sell it, we won't force it. I will go back and tell them. If they are willing to make a trip, let them come with a letter of introduction. If it is too far, forget it."

Uncle: "This thing is of no use here. It's not food. It doesn't matter whether there is a letter of introduction. If no one wants this thing by the end of the year, maybe it will be used for firewood."

After that, the uncle went to the shelf at the back and pulled out a bag among the pile of sundries.He weighed it on the scale and said, "Young man, this is 50 kilograms in total. Some of them look too good to be taken. I'll give you 30 kilograms. Do you think it's okay?"

Wang Ye: "Uncle, can you just tell me how much it is? I don't understand this thing either. Besides, as long as it's not outrageous, that's all."

According to the thinking of a later generation, Wang Ye's words are the rhythm of being slaughtered, but such things do not exist in this era. They can have a bad attitude, but they will never lose their conscience.

Salesman: "I took a look just now. The ginseng seeds are priced at 5 yuan per pound. This is the price set by the above, you know."

Wang Ye doesn't care about this little money. After a dozen or twenty years, Wang Ye will earn back not only ten thousand times, but also one hundred thousand or one million, all at his discretion.He took out fifteen big black ten cards from the bag and handed them to the uncle. He picked up the bag and left the seed station.

Carrying the bag, Wang Ye wandered to a deserted corner and put the seeds into a space. Wang Ye returned to the road and looked around for a local state-owned restaurant.He wanted to see if he could meet a powerful master, and it wouldn't hurt to learn a little secretly.

Not long after walking, he saw a state-owned restaurant. When Wang Ye ordered dishes, he was disappointed. Not to mention all vegetarian dishes, wild vegetable steamed buns were also on the menu.Wang Ye's mental power clearly detected that there was meat in the kitchen. Although it was not much, it was still no problem to make a few meat dishes.

Wang Ye knew that this was reserved for an acquaintance, and he was self-aware that these things were all a favor now.It's not like he can fool you with just a few words, let alone offering a high price.No one would believe a sixteen-year-old child with a foreign accent.
